faq_items.question_zh: 可以先确认材料和生产规格吗？
faq_items.answer_zh: 可以。请在询价时说明用途和关注的材料规格，我们会根据可供产品确认具体参数及样品安排。
faq_items.question_en: Can I confirm materials and specifications before ordering?
faq_items.answer_en: Tell us the application and the specifications you need to confirm, and we will confirm the available options before you commit. Material samples or a printed proof can be arranged for most media — ask when you request your quotation.

faq_items.question_zh: 没有设计稿，也能制作吗？
faq_items.answer_zh: 可以提供基础文件检查和简单调整；复杂修改或原创设计会另行报价。
faq_items.question_en: Can you help if I do not have print-ready artwork?
faq_items.answer_en: We can provide basic file checks and simple adjustments. Complex revisions or original design work are quoted separately.

faq_items.answer_zh: 我们会根据订单尺寸、重量、包装和目的地协调运输方案，具体费用与交期以项目确认结果为准。
faq_items.question_en: What payment and delivery methods are available?
faq_items.answer_en: Payment is by bank transfer (T/T) against a proforma invoice, so the specification, quantity and total are agreed in writing before you pay. Production time is confirmed in your quotation; sea freight to main Australian ports typically takes around 40 days in transit. Delivery terms and any import charges for your destination are stated in the quotation before you confirm.

faq_items.question_zh: 如何处理印刷质量问题？
faq_items.answer_zh: 生产前会确认文件和规格。如出现影响使用的生产质量问题，请提供照片和订单信息，我们会核实并协商处理方案。
faq_items.question_en: What if there is a print quality issue?
faq_items.answer_en: Files and specifications are confirmed before production, and photos of the finished goods and their export packing are shared with you before dispatch. If a production quality issue still affects use, tell us with photos and order details — we will prioritize reprinting or agree on another appropriate solution.
